versions.changelog:
- Improved guardrails: generating a cover from a style word alone is now blocked; a concrete topic is required to proceed without a source photo.
- Headline handling: if user-supplied title copy exists, it will be rendered in the top or bottom third of the cover; otherwise, a clean text-safe zone is provided for future overlays.
- Enhanced brief logic: style direction defaults only if a topic or photo exists; style alone no longer triggers image generation.
- User confirmation step now includes headline placement or text-safe zone details, and prohibits batch (carousel/mood-variant) output on a single request.
- Documentation clarified to prevent topic invention and to ensure stricter input validation before image generation.
- Obsolete skill-card.md file removed.
Publish the reviewed Zhongcao Cover Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
